_about: Manual review of the by-omission run, checked against raw output. kind: documented | design | vacuous | interface.

ipc-unix-socket-in-denied-dir-by-omissio: Landlock does not mediate connect() to a pathname unix socket, so a socket in an ungranted directory stays reachable. This is the gap the original contract already documents; it holds in the granted model too.
read-allow-symlink-into-deny-by-omission: The granted read path is itself a symlink into the protected area. nono resolves grants through symlinks (documented in its Path Resolution), so granting the link grants its target and the secret is read. codex refuses to build the sandbox.
read-allow-symlink-no-reopen-by-omission: The granted read path is itself a symlink into the protected area. nono resolves grants through symlinks (documented in its Path Resolution), so granting the link grants its target and the secret is read. codex refuses to build the sandbox.
secrets-read-allow-symlink-into-deny-by-: The granted read path is itself a symlink into the protected area. nono resolves grants through symlinks (documented in its Path Resolution), so granting the link grants its target and the secret is read. codex refuses to build the sandbox.
isolation-root-mount-bypass-denied-by-om: mount operations fail in the container even without a sandbox (no CAP_SYS_ADMIN), so the attack proves nothing on this host.
mount fails in the container without a sandbox; nothing is proven here.
read-allow-symlink-into-deny-by-omission: codex refuses to build the sandbox when a read grant resolves through a symlink ('cannot enforce sandbox read-only path'): the attack is stopped and so is the control.
read-allow-symlink-no-reopen-by-omission: codex refuses to build the sandbox when a read grant resolves through a symlink: fails closed, control broke too.
secrets-read-allow-symlink-into-deny-by-: codex refuses to build the sandbox when a read grant resolves through a symlink: fails closed, control broke too.
